integrity: Two separately implemented standard-library Python enumerators agree on all 120 state vectors, all 216 length-six transitions, parity components, graph structure and eccentricities; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Pappus incidence graph; three distinguished colours; precisely alternating six-cycle switches. Complete finite search proof, not a generalization to larger graphs. The unrestricted Kempe-class count may appear in earlier enumerations; novelty claimed only for the length-restricted transition graph, exact graph isomorphism, parity sufficiency and metric comparison. Equivalent unindexed work or supplementary data cannot be excluded. The twenty-state color-name quotient, its thirty-six edges and sign obstruction have already been calculated and are not new; the exact six-sheeted hexagon-only lift and its distances are the stated contribution.
title: Hexagon-switch components of three-edge-colourings of the Pappus graph
